THE BALCONY SHOP

Licensed to DOCUSEN WENDELL on 5 August 2022 — 4.13 years ago — as Beauty Salons.

1501 PIKE PL # 510 unit 510. In Main Arcade.

NAICS 812112Other services4 years

Need a haircut, buzz cut or beard trim? Balcony Barber Shop on Pike Place Market's Mezzanine Level is open 7 days a week. Barber Wendell has decades of experience cutting both men and women. He offered discounts for seniors too.
